content.text: I'll help you create a rectangular box with the specified dimensions. Let me first calculate the necessary coordinates and dimensions for creating this box using blocks.

input.PythonCode:
# Box dimensions
outer_width = 220  # mm (x-direction)
outer_length = 300  # mm (y-direction)
outer_height = 160  # mm (z-direction)
wall_thickness = 8  # mm
bottom_thickness = 12  # mm

# Calculate inner dimensions
inner_width = outer_width - 2 * wall_thickness
inner_length = outer_length - 2 * wall_thickness
inner_height = outer_height - bottom_thickness

print(f"Outer box dimensions: {outer_width} x {outer_length} x {outer_height} mm")
print(f"Inner cavity dimensions: {inner_width} x {inner_length} x {inner_height} mm")
print(f"Inner cavity position: ({wall_thickness}, {wall_thickness}, {bottom_thickness})")

# We'll create the box by:
# 1. Creating a solid outer block
# 2. Subtracting an inner block to create the cavity

print("\nBlock parameters:")
print(f"Block 1 (outer): size=({outer_width}, {outer_length}, {outer_height}), position=(0, 0, 0), subtraction=False")
print(f"Block 2 (inner cavity): size=({inner_width}, {inner_length}, {inner_height}), position=({wall_thickness}, {wall_thickness}, {bottom_thickness}), subtraction=True")
